nodes.name: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates automatic debuffs that perks inflict on enemies. Contains logic for ~20 perks (Penance, Melting Shred, Fungal Prototype, Venom Spitter, Toxin Caster, Gorecast, Splinter, Vicious Edge, Caci Spirit, Woof Spirit, Gravitational Enforcer, Ice Burst, Bellowing Ember, Frostbite, Gelid Lance, Weakening, Sunburn, Fiery Pursuit, Pyre Bloom, Runic Blades, Hypnotist, Cryo Engine). Also delegates to enemyHpEffects for enemy-HP-gated debuffs.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports AutoDebuffInput interface, calcActualHpFillPct, and getAutoDebuffs functions.

nodes.name: Perkbasedmg.ts
nodes.summary: Core perk-based damage definition file (1687 lines). Defines PerkDmgDef interface with damage types, scaling modes, hit counts, HP gates, secondary effects, trigger chains, and slider definitions. Contains a massive PERK_DMG_DEFS array (~80+ perk entries) including Dragon State, Dragon Claw, Spore Burst, Springblast, Basic/Buni/Mageling Spirit, Whirlwind, Volatile Shell, Royal Finisher, Dark Harvest, Pyre Bloom, Bastion Ballista, Star Struck, etc. Also exports HpGate interface and isHpGateActive/gateThreshold helpers used by raceEffects.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports many interfaces (PerkDmgDef, PerkDmgCtx, HpGate, SecondaryEffect, PerkSliderDef), functions (calcSpringblastBaseDamage, calcBomberChargeBaseDamage, isHpGateActive, gateThreshold, findPerkDmgDef), and the PERK_DMG_DEFS constant array.

nodes.name: potions.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Potion interface and a static list of potions (Rage Potion, Poison Potion) with their descriptions and colors. Exports a POTIONS array and POTION_MAP lookup.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports Potion interface, POTIONS array, and POTION_MAP record.

nodes.name: procCoefficients.ts
nodes.summary: Lookup tables for M1/M2 proc coefficients per weapon type and weapon art proc coefficients. Covers ~30 weapon types (Fists, Chain Fists, various swords, daggers, spears, mallets, kamas, scythes, lances, chainsaws, shields, magic weapons, guns) and 5 weapon arts (Lunge, Spin, Rapid Stab, Slam, Laser). Provides DEFAULT_PROC_COEFF fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports WEAPON_PROC_COEFFS, WA_PROC_COEFFS records and DEFAULT_PROC_COEFF constant.

nodes.name: raceEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Defines race-conditional effects based on HP gates (e.g., HUMAN gets 1.2x dmg and 20% DR below 50% HP). Also provides Ork Tenacity helpers that filter non-debuff buffs and calculate bonus from buff count.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports RaceConditionalEffect interface, getActiveRaceEffect, getOrkTenacityBuffs, and calcOrkTenacityBonus functions.

nodes.name: Runebasedmg.ts
nodes.summary: Defines rune-based damage definitions (RUNE_DMG_DEFS array) for ~16 runes: Ancient Cleric, Beenade, Boostshroom, Thunderous Charge, Sporeling Toss, Foot Dive, Caci, Cacitrops, Hex Web, Brainblast, Fireball, Rocky Tail, False Sun, Snoeball, Rage, Weakening Roar. Each rune has damage types, scalings, hit counts, optional sliders, shields, and conditions. Contains internal calculateRuneHealScaling helper.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports RuneDmgCtx, RuneSliderDef, RuneShieldDef, RuneDmgDef interfaces and RUNE_DMG_DEFS array.

nodes.name: selfDamagePerks.ts
nodes.summary: Defines self-damage perk definitions (Undead Might, Explosive Charge, Dark Magic, Bombardier, Steam Powered) with their damage types, DR per stack, proc chances, and flat damage values. Provides calcSelfDamage function that computes damage taken by the player including multi-target falloff and defense multipliers.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports SelfDamagePerkDef interface, SELF_DAMAGE_PERK_DEFS array, and calcSelfDamage function.

nodes.name: stanceOverlays.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves weapon stance overlays that change the M2 attack type based on equipped perks and weapon. Handles Mine, Cosmic Ray, Blaster Ring (Fists/Weapon), and Locked And Loaded (Fists/Weapon) overlays.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports StanceOverlayResult, StanceOverlayCtx interfaces and resolveStanceOverlay function.

nodes.name: statboost.ts
nodes.summary: Applies stat-modifying perks in a defined execution order via PERK_REGISTRY. Handles 16 perks: Roaring Heads, Lucky, Quick Witted, Whirl Foot, Carapace, Extra Layers, Frozen Heart, Immovable, Righted Wrongs, Rocky Body, Spellshield, Strong Tides, Swift Guard, True Balance, Brawny, Weight Distribution. Each perk converts or modifies stats based on other stat values.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports OFFENSIVE_BOOSTS array and applyStatBoostPerks function. Uses a PerkHandler type and ordered PERK_REGISTRY.

nodes.name: SummonData.ts
nodes.summary: Defines summon creature data (Mage Bomber, Blessedling), summon stat calculation, summon cap (base 15 + Swarm perk), WA-to-summon mapping, and summon perk definitions. Provides calcSummonStat and calcMaxSummonCount functions.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports calcSummonStat, calcMaxSummonCount functions, SUMMON_MAP, WA_SUMMON_MAP constants.

nodes.name: TypedDmgBoost.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates type-specific damage multipliers from perks that boost certain damage types (Glyph Conduit→magic, Rage→physical+extensions, Photosynthesis→holy+earth, Hex Shield→all types). Combines buff potency and perk amounts to produce per-type damage and heal multipliers.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports TypedDmgBoostCtx, TypedDmgBoostEntry, TypedDmgBoostResult interfaces and calcTypedDmgBoosts function.

nodes.name: weapon base dmg.ts
nodes.summary: Static lookup table of base M1/M2 damage values for all weapon types (~30 types). Each entry specifies per-hit damage arrays with optional hit counts (multi-hit), M1 finisher flag, and M2 charge mechanics for Rifle.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports WEAPON_BASE_DMG array. Uses WeaponBaseDmg type from lib/types.

nodes.name: Weaponartcheck.ts
nodes.summary: Validates whether a player meets requirements to equip a weapon art. Checks weapon type, scaling requirements, stat requirements, guild (Monk), bothParts constraints, and scalingExemptWeaponTypes. Provides both boolean checkWA and descriptive getUnmetReqs functions.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports checkWA and getUnmetReqs functions. Internal helpers for scaling and stat requirement checks.

nodes.name: weaponArts.ts
nodes.summary: Master list of all weapon arts (~40+ entries) with descriptions, cooldowns, base damage formulas, damage types, hit breakdowns, scaling info, and requirements. Covers Lunge, Spin, Rapid Stabs, Javelin, Rend, Slam, various monk arts, magic arts (Laser, Mines, Mage Bomb), summon arts, holy arts (Lesser Heal, Holy Phalanx), hex arts (Cursed Ground, Jinx), elemental arts (Flame Slash, Earthquake, Waterfall), and Starstream.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports WeaponArt, WeaponArtRequirement, WAIndividualHit interfaces and WEAPON_ARTS array.

nodes.name: weaponConditionalBoosts.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates conditional damage multipliers for perks that apply only to specific weapon types and hit scopes (M1 Finisher or M2). Handles Aggressive Personality (War Hammer/Mallets) and Piercer (various weapons with doubled effect for specific types).
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports WeaponHitScope type and getWeaponConditionalBoost function.

nodes.name: DidYouMean.svelte
nodes.summary: Svelte component that displays 'Did you mean?' search suggestions when no exact results are found. Renders clickable chips for name/perk matches with text highlighting. Dispatches 'select' event when a suggestion is clicked.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 4 (uses createEventDispatcher, export let). Imports highlightTextParts from lib/utils.

nodes.name: DmgTotalTooltip.svelte
nodes.summary: Svelte component that renders a damage breakdown tooltip with an animated pie chart. Groups computed hit types, shows per-type totals and percentages, and displays individual entries with badges. Uses Svelte 5 runes ($props, $derived, $state).
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 (uses $props, $derived, $state). Imports ComputedHit, BADGE_CONFIG from lib/dmgTypes and Badge component.

nodes.name: DraconicAbilityStats.svelte
nodes.summary: Simple Svelte component displaying draconic ability stats: damage type, scaling, poise damage, and optional holy/water heal values. Pure presentational component.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 4 (uses export let). No imports.

nodes.name: EmotionalTracker.svelte
nodes.summary: Svelte component providing an emotional state selector (Buff/Debuff/Both) with button toggles and a slider. Reads/writes emotional state to the build store. Styled with color-coded states (green=buff, red=debuff, purple=both).
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 4 (uses $:, export let). Imports build store and Badge component.

nodes.name: Highlight.svelte
nodes.summary: Minimal Svelte component that renders text with matched query portions highlighted using <mark> tags. Uses highlightTextParts utility.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 4 (uses $:, export let). Imports highlightTextParts from lib/utils.

nodes.name: LevelBar.svelte
nodes.summary: Complex Svelte component for level editing and an interactive HP bar. Features: inline level editing with keyboard support, draggable HP fill bar with mouse tracking, protection shield overlay, lost HP zone, threshold line display, and localStorage persistence. Calculates effective max HP considering protection values.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 4 (uses $:, export let). Imports build store, MAX_LEVEL, calcBaseMaxHP, localStorage keys from lib/constants, and Badge component.

nodes.name: AppHeader.svelte
nodes.summary: Application header component with title, BuildSaves integration, and animated Overview/Analyze tab switcher. Features a sliding bubble animation between tabs, keyboard Tab key navigation, and responsive design.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 4 (uses createEventDispatcher, onMount/onDestroy, $:). Imports BuildSaves component.

nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export file that re-exports everything from ./constants/index. Serves as the single import path for all game constants throughout the codebase.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Single-line re-export: export * from './constants/index'.

nodes.name: boosts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines numeric constants for damage boost calculations. Includes simple multiplier-per-stack boosts (Blood Thirsty, Venom Spitter, Perfection, Stealth, etc.), complex boost internals (Ferocity, Spirit Winds, Guardian Spin, Thief Training), and special ability constants (Heat Drill, Essence Ray, Solar Light, Steam Powered).
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports ~90 named numeric constants.

nodes.name: buffs.ts
nodes.summary: Defines numeric constants for buff/debuff potency, duration, and effect values. Organized into sections: potion constants, item buff potencies (rune-granted, weapon-art-granted), basic debuff pool, perk-granted buffs (Perfection, Bounce, Toadzerker, Springblast, etc.), buff potency modifiers, generic debuff modifiers, and Propelling Fun constants.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports ~130 named numeric constants.
